notes.title: Alpha Demo Update 0.5.0
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha Demo Update v.0.5.0 Now Live!
[/h1]
Greetings adventurers!

We’ve just pushed a fresh update to the Alpha Demo of To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora, bringing more engaging tactical goodness your way and laying the groundwork for bigger things on the horizon.

[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2]
[b]Turn Order Indicator[/b]
Stay one step ahead! You can now see the turn order in battle - vital for mastering the tactical flow and planning your squad’s next moves.

[b]Enemy Attack Animations[/b]
Battles now come alive with new enemy attack animations for a more pulse-pounding, pixel-perfect RPG feel.

[b]Redemption Codes[/b]
Got a code from our Substack or X page? You can now redeem in-game loot and cosmetics using reward codes - keep an eye out for more!

[b]Setting the Stage...[/b]
Systems are being slotted into place for item retention and recruit permanence, but how it all plays out? That remains a mystery... for now.

[h2][b]What’s Next? Early Access Is On the Way![/b][/h2]
We're hard at work on the Early Access build, and it's shaping up to be a generational leap beyond what's shown in the alpha demo. Here’s what’s in the pipeline:

[b]Full Chapter 1 Story[/b] — Dive deeper into the mystery of the Wildlands and your unlikely hero’s journey.

[b]Completely Redesigned UI[/b] — Cleaner, crisper, and smoother than ever, while still keeping that nostalgic pixel charm we all love.

[b]Deeper Battle System[/b] — New tactical options and mechanics to challenge and reward strategic play.

[b]Tons of QoL Updates[/b] — Based on all the amazing feedback from YOU, our alpha players!

[h2][b]Important Note: Alpha Save Wipe Incoming![/b][/h2]
Please note that all save files will be wiped at the end of the alpha demo period as we prepare for the transition to Early Access. Now’s your chance to experiment, explore, and cause a little chaos before the next phase begins.

Thanks again to everyone who’s played, tested, and shared their thoughts! We’re building something special together. Now go forth, collect Nethershards and may your hero live just long enough to make death interesting.

notes.title: Alpha Demo Update - Version 0.4.3
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce our latest alpha demo build - version 0.4.3!

As we continue to develop Wildlands of Faenora, we're so thrilled about all of the feedback so far and we're weaving in improvements alongside our development plan as we build and build.

Here is a summary of the major changes in the latest update:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Customization: Customize your hero by clicking the Wardrobe button on the Squad Formation screen and find new cosmetics spread throughout the Wildlands. (Account required to unlock new cosmetics)
[*] New Item System: Completely revamped item systems with 20 item rankings and each item receiving a different rarity when obtained (common, rare – 10% stat bonus, epic – 20% stat bonus, legendary – 30% stat bonus).
[*] New Items: More than 80 new items to discover in the alpha demo!
[*] New Beasts: Seek out and challenge the Red Dragon, Gold Dragon, Blood Tiamat and Gold Tiamat, if you dare!
[*] Winter Wonderland: New battle backgrounds and holiday themed cosmetics (unlockable for a limited time)!
[/list]
[b]Other Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bugfix galore, including a bug where the Dojo would soft lock the game.
[/list]

The balancing in the current version might seem a bit off, because this doesn't include certain features that we are still building. One of the exciting new additions to come is an item permanence feature (so you can carry forward certain weapons and equipment from one playthrough to the next)! It is still possible to beat the demo for those who master the strategy and get your hero strong enough! 

Thank you to everyone who has played the alpha demo so far! We have much more planned as we're leading up to our Early Access launch. 

Please remember that this is an alpha demo of a game still in development, so you may encounter certain bugs and there are a number of missing features and unfulfilled ambitions. Thanks for your excitement and understanding! We're working on it!

Hope you enjoy these updates!

notes.title: Alpha Demo Launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45085602/b0868dccc465f98ed24877f4387b39ada385fc03.png[/img]

We are excited to announce the launch of our Alpha Demo of 'To The Grave: The Wildlands of Faenora'! 

This will give you a chunky glimpse into this pixel art, roguelite tactics RPG game. This demo launch just marks the beginning of our journey. 

Here's our promise to you: 

- We will do our best to make this game the most fun, most engaging tactics RPG experience you've ever played! This means that the demo only scratches the surface on the deep customization and strategic layers that we have planned. 

Here's our ask from you: 

- Please play the game and, if you enjoy it, please tell your friends and wishlist us! 
- Let us know if you encounter any bugs, have any suggestions or if you love what we're building (as your encouragement and support truly means a lot to us)!

Also, if you create an account and login to play between Sept 23 - 30, then we'll send 10 nethershards to your account (usable in-game for special actions, like promoting characters early and buying unique items from Moochkin)! 

As a small indie team, we might not be able to do all of the fancy stuff that the big guys do, but hopefully you'll feel the love and fun in what we've made here. 

We'll be participating in Steam Next Fest in October and would love your support there too! In the coming months, we will also be sharing more about our Early Access plans.

(Note: Save game data will not carry over from the Alpha Demo to the full, final game.)
